outcome: utilization of reproductive, maternal, newborn and child health (RMNCH) services
treatment for pneumonia in children <5 years
cohort: The study analyzed routine monitoring data for indicators of RMNCH care utilization in Pakistan.
finding: Utilization of RMNCH services decreased during the first and second waves of the COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan, with the greatest reduction observed in children under 5 treated for pneumonia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates dropped by 57%, and institutional deliveries and first postnatal visits both decreased by 37%.
